synthetic_tests.scope: Temporary artificial byte strings and small row-count fixtures; tensor numerical inspection stubbed in tests. Identity, draft/incomplete/failed artifact, overwrite, and publication-after-preflight checks.

independent_review.reviewer: Runner implementer, plus root source review
independent_review.scope: Reads final source and verifies use of runner.locked_inputs before output publication; not a full-data execution.

publication_rules: Outer immutable release manifest must bind builder and test bytes before use. An embedded self-hash is provenance, not authorization. Private paths stay outside the repository.
remaining_gate: All final protocol/extraction locks, completed original baseline and all14 feature artifacts must exist and pass the exact runner preflight; none are invented by this helper.
